deposit money: Every month I deposit money in my bank account so that I can buy a new laptop next year.
我每個月都把錢存進銀行帳戶，好在明年買一台新筆電。
deposit sediment: When the river slows down near the sea, it begins to deposit sediment and slowly forms new land.
河流在靠近海的地方流速減緩，便開始沉積泥沙，慢慢形成新的陸地。
pay a deposit: To keep the apartment for us, the owner asked us to pay a deposit of one month's rent.
為了替我們保留這間公寓，屋主要我們付一個月房租當訂金。
deposit the bags: Hotel guests can deposit the bags at the front desk and go sightseeing before they check in.
飯店房客可以把袋子放在櫃台，在入住前先去觀光。
depress prices: Too much rain this summer may depress prices of watermelons because farmers will have more than they can sell.
今年夏天雨量過多可能會壓低西瓜價格，因為農民的產量會超過能賣出的量。
depress the economy: Experts warned that the long war could depress the economy and cause many people to lose their jobs.
專家警告，這場長期戰爭可能使經濟低迷，並導致許多人失業。
press the button to depress: To open the machine, press the button to depress the lever, and then pull the cover up slowly.
要打開機器，先按下按鈕把壓桿壓下，然後慢慢把蓋子往上拉。
be depressed about: Tom seemed to be depressed about failing his driving test, so his friends took him out for dinner.
湯姆似乎為駕照考試沒過而沮喪，所以朋友們帶他出去吃晚餐。
derive pleasure from: Many retired people derive pleasure from gardening because it keeps them busy and close to nature.
許多退休人士從園藝中得到樂趣，因為這讓他們保持忙碌又能親近大自然。
derive from Latin: Many English words, such as 'animal' and 'library,' were derived from Latin a long time ago.
許多英文字，例如 animal 和 library，很久以前就是源自拉丁文。
derive benefits: Students who exercise regularly derive benefits such as better sleep and stronger focus in class.
規律運動的學生能獲益，例如睡得更好、上課更專注。
derive a conclusion: After studying the data from the experiment, the scientists were able to derive a conclusion about the new medicine.
研究實驗數據後，科學家們得以對這種新藥得出結論。
descend into chaos: When the lights suddenly went out, the crowded concert hall began to descend into chaos.
燈光突然熄滅時，擁擠的音樂廳開始陷入混亂。
be descended from: My classmate claims to be descended from a famous general who lived over three hundred years ago.
我同學聲稱自己是三百多年前一位著名將軍的後代。
descend on the city: Every New Year's Eve, thousands of tourists descend on the city to watch the fireworks at Taipei 101.
每年跨年夜，數千名遊客湧入城市觀賞台北101的煙火。
descend the stairs: Grandpa has to descend the stairs slowly and hold the rail because his knees hurt.
爺爺必須慢慢下樓梯並扶著欄杆，因為他的膝蓋會痛。
deserve praise: The volunteers who cleaned the beach all weekend deserve praise for their hard work.
整個週末清理海灘的志工們，他們的辛勞值得稱讚。
deserve a break: You have been studying for six hours, so you deserve a break and a cup of hot tea.
你已經念了六個小時的書，該休息一下、喝杯熱茶了。
get what one deserves: The thief who stole money from the old lady was caught, and everyone said he would get what he deserves.
從老太太那裡偷錢的小偷被抓到了，大家都說他罪有應得。
deserve better: She works harder than anyone in the office, and she deserves better than such a low salary.
她比辦公室任何人都努力，她值得比這麼低的薪水更好的待遇。
desire change: Many young voters desire change and hope the new leader will create more jobs.
許多年輕選民渴望改變，並希望新領袖能創造更多工作機會。
leave much to be desired: The food at the night market is cheap, but the service there can often leave much to be desired.
夜市的食物很便宜，但服務有待改進。
desire for power: Driven by a strong desire for power, the king made his people pay heavy taxes and fight endless wars.
在強烈的權力慾驅使下，國王讓人民繳納重稅並打無止盡的仗。
despair of ever finding: After searching for hours in the rain, we began to despair of ever finding our lost dog.
在雨中找了好幾個小時後，我們開始不指望找到走失的狗了。
drive someone to despair: The endless noise from the construction site next door could drive someone to despair.
隔壁工地沒完沒了的噪音會使人絕望。
in despair: When he saw his low test score, he put his head in his hands in despair.
看到自己很低的考試分數時，他絕望地雙手抱頭。
detect a change: Doctors use this machine to detect a change in a patient's heartbeat during surgery.
醫生在手術中用這台機器察覺病人心跳的變化。
detect a hint of anger: Although she was smiling, I could detect a hint of anger in her voice when she answered.
雖然她在微笑，但她回答時我能察覺她聲音裡的一絲怒意。
detect cancer early: Regular health checks can help doctors detect cancer early, when it is much easier to treat.
定期健康檢查能幫助醫生早期發現癌症，那時治療容易得多。
detect a lie: The police used a special machine to detect a lie by measuring the man's heartbeat and breathing.
警方使用一台特殊機器，藉由測量那名男子的心跳和呼吸來識破謊言。
